metadata.case_name: CHUI WING LAI v. CHUNG DOK RESTAURANT LTD. AND PANG HEUNG LIN (THIRD PARTY)

injuries.description: Wing Lai had first to second degree burns over 40% of her body
injuries.body_part: trunk, thighs, lower abdomen, buttocks, groin, genitalia
source: Wing Lai had first to second degree burns over 40% of her body

injuries.description: circumferential burn over her left forearm and hand
source: circumferential burn over her left forearm and hand
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: Wing Lai was found to have electrolyte disturbance resulting in generalised convulsion during her period in hospital
conspicuous scarring on her trunk, thighs and left hand caused by scold and chemical burns to 40% of her body
pain and itchiness in the vagina during the summer months

psychological harm: embarrassment, shy, quiet, more withdrawn than other girls of her age, concern about disfigurement, avoidance (wants to wear trousers to cover up), and predicted adverse effect on heterosexual relationships and marriage prospects

treatments_received: Conservative treatment including dressing, analgesia, antibiotic and intravenous fluid replacement were given to the victim.
A split skin graft from her right thigh to her right lip region was performed on the burn area
wore pressure garments to her left hand for one month, to her chest area for six months, and to her lower abdomen, buttocks, groin and thighs for nearly 6 years
treatments_future: may later require an operation to relieve the contractures of the scars
psychological counselling as recommended by Dr. David Y.H. Ho for Wing Lai and her parents
follow-up treatment to continue until she is 18 years, including visits to a doctor and an occupational therapist at Princess Margaret Hospital

losses.description: Conspicuous scarring on her trunk, thighs and left hand; ugly red raised hypertrophic scarring causing permanent cosmetic disability
Shy, too quiet and more withdrawn than other girls of her age; tends to hold back in making friends at school or outside her immediate family

Scars could be a source of considerable embarrassment when she grows older and may interfere with her marriage prospects; future heterosexual relationships and prospects of marriage would be adversely affected

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Embarrassment during physical education classes leading to wearing trousers to cover up and avoidance of activities where scars may be visible
